title: Best of China | A Journey Through the Golden Triangle
highlights: Discover China’s Golden Triangle as you journey through iconic cities like Beijing, Xi'an, and Shanghai, experiencing a blend of ancient wonders and modern cityscapes.
Step into a world of magic and thrills at Shanghai Disneyland, where Disney classics come alive with cutting-edge attractions, themed lands, and unforgettable experiences.
Marvel at the 8,000 life-sized warriors that have guarded China’s first emperor in the afterlife at the Museum of Qin Terra Cotta Warriors and Horses.
Experience the grandeur of the Great Wall of China at Mutianyu, one of the most scenic and well-preserved sections, offering stunning views of the mountains.
Dive into the action at Universal Studios Beijing, where thrilling rides, attractions, and live shows bring your favorite movies to life in one of the world’s most exciting theme parks.

know_before_you_go: Travelers need a Chinese visa, so apply in advance to avoid delays.
The official currency is the Chinese Yuan (CNY); exchange some cash for small purchases.
Wear comfortable shoes, as some sections including the Great Wall of China have steep steps and uneven paths.
English is limited; downloading a translation app can be helpful.
Many sites like Google and WhatsApp are restricted, so install a VPN beforehand.
Modest clothing is recommended when visiting places like the Jade Buddha Temple.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Beijing | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to the capital of China, Beijing! Upon arrival at the airport, get transferred to your hotel. After check-in, spend the day at your leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can visit the Lama Temple, a masterpiece of Tibetan Buddhist architecture adorned with intricate carvings. Also, you can witness Beijing’s artistic pulse at the avant-garde 798 Art Zone or induge in China’s rich history at the National Museum of China, home to fascinating cultural treasures.

items.title: Check-in at Deluxe Hotel
items.hotel: Holiday Inn Express Beijing Airport Zone

days.title: Beijing Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, explore Beijing on a sightseeing tour and visit Tiananmen Square, the world’s largest public square. Next, witness the Monument to the People’s Heroes and the Mausoleum of Mao Zedong, each offering a glimpse into the nation’s past. Then, step into the legendary Forbidden City, a UNESCO World Heritage site that once housed emperors for over 500 years. Also, marvel at the artistry behind China’s revered jade at a jade factory and admire the intricate architecture of the Temple of Heaven.

days.title: Visit to Mutianyu Great Wall & Summer Palace
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to the iconic Mutianyu Great Wall, a UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site. Upon arrival, ascend via cable car or ski lift to reach the wall. Once there, explore its historic watchtowers while soaking in the panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. Afterward, visit the Summer Palace to learn about the story of the powerful Empress Dowager Cixi, known as the "Dragon Lady," and her lasting influence on Chinese history. Afterwards, get driven to your hotel.

items.title: Full-Day Great Wall & Summer Palace Tour, Beijing

days.title: Visit to Universal Studios Beijing
days.desc: Today, head out for an unforgettable adventure at Universal Studios Beijing, China’s entertainment hub that brings iconic movies to life. Once there, step into a world of action and excitement as you explore immersive themed lands like Jurassic World, Transformers, and Harry Potter. Also, enjoy heart-pounding rides, live shows, and cutting-edge attractions that transport you into the heart of your favorite films. After an amazing day, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Xian via Bullet Train | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After check-out, head to Beijing West Station on your own and board the high-speed bullet train to Xi'an, one of China’s ancient capitals. Upon arrival, head to your hotel on your own. Post check-in, spend your day at leisure, where you can head out and soak in the vibrant atmosphere of the Muslim Quarter, where you can explore traditional crafts. Also, you can try amazing street food or you can visit the Shaanxi History Museum, housing ancient artifacts of this ancient city.

days.title: Xian Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, embark on a sightseeing tour of Xi'an, beginning with the famous Museum of Qin Terra Cotta Warriors and Horses, home to over 8,000 life-sized warriors guarding China’s first emperor in the afterlife. Next, marvel at the Ancient City Wall, one of the best-preserved fortifications, and explore the Xi'an Bell Tower, a symbol of the city's rich history. Lastly, visit the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, a UNESCO World Heritage site once housing sacred Buddhist scriptures from the Tang Dynasty.

items.title: Museum of qin terra cotta warriors and horses

days.title: Fly to Shanghai | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to the airport for your flight to Shanghai. Upon arrival in Shanghai, get driven to your hotel. Post check-in, spend the rest of the day at your leisure, where you can head out and stroll along the Bund, Shanghai’s iconic waterfront promenade, ofering stunning views of the Huangpu River. Also, you can discover China’s artistic and historical heritage at the Shanghai Museum, or indulge in a shopping spree on Nanjing Road, one of the world’s vibrant shopping streets.

days.title: Half-Day Shanghai City Tour | Visit to Oriental Pearl Tower | Hungpu River Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, dive into Shanghai's rich history on a city tour. Start with a visit to the Jade Buddha Temple, home to jade statues from Myanmar. Next, stroll through the Yu Garden, a Ming Dynasty masterpiece, & visit the city’s oldest Longhua Temple. Then, ascend the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower & soak in Shanghai's skyline views. Conclude your day with a Huangpu River cruise from Shiliupu Wharf, soaking in the contrast between the modernity of Pudong’s skyscrapers and the historic beauty of the Bund.

days.title: Visit to Shanghai Disneyland
days.desc: Today, head to Shanghai Disneyland on your own and step into a world of magic, offering a blend of the iconic Disney charm and Chinese culture. Once there, explore seven themed lands, each offering immersive experiences, from the futuristic Tomorrowland to the stunning Fantasyland with its Sleeping Beauty Castle. Also, feel the thrill of world-class attractions like TRON Lightcycle Power Run and Pirates of the Caribbean. Get a chance to witness live shows, parades, and fireworks.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check out from your hotel in Shanghai. Then board your transfer to the airport for your flight back home, marking the end of your amazing China trip!
